task.title: Deleting an image tag
task.shortdesc: To remove a specific version of a container image from a repository, you can delete its tag from the Red Hat Quay v2 UI. Depending on your time machine retention settings, you might be able to revert a deleted tag later.

step.cmd: On the Repositories page of the v2 UI, click the name of the image you want to delete, for example, quay/admin/busybox.
Click the More Actions drop-down menu.

note.p: If desired, you could click Make Public or Make Private.

step.cmd: Type confirm in the box, and then click Delete.
After deletion, you are returned to the Repositories page.

note.p: Deleting an image tag can be reverted based on the amount of time allotted assigned to the time machine feature. For more information, see "Reverting tag changes".
